_doc: The scroll story: one beat per scroll step. 'date' is where the pen stands when the beat is centred. Text in {braces} is filled in by compute.py from the data (gap = the smoothed schedule gap at that date; cross = the month the record crosses the script; low = the lowest reading and its month). 'refs' are event or prediction ids whose sources back the beat.

beats.title: The script is printed
beats.body: AI 2027 tells a month-by-month story that ends in superhuman AI. The red line is the scenario's pace: AI research progress, sped up by AI itself, exactly as the scenario expects it. The pen records where reality actually is on that path.

beats.title: Stumbling agents, right on cue
beats.body: Agents arrive as 'personal assistants' that impress in demos and stumble in practice. ChatGPT agent launches; METR finds experienced developers 19% slower with early-2025 AI tools. Lab safety tests surface risky behavior even earlier than the script. Reading: {gap}.

beats.title: The pen sags below the line
beats.body: Named benchmarks miss their dates. OSWorld's 65% mark lands about five months late, SWE-bench's 85% is still out of reach, and no one is seen running the scenario's giant training run. Reading: {gap}.

beats.title: The authors grade themselves
beats.body: The AI 2027 team scores 2025 at about 65% of the scenario's pace. Benchmarks and AI-assisted research are the furthest behind. Reading: {gap}. The record's lowest point: {low}.

beats.title: The crossing
beats.body: Anthropic keeps its strongest model, Mythos Preview, away from the public, about nine months before the scenario's version of that moment. The same model clears SWE-bench's 85% bar. The record crosses the script in {cross}.

beats.title: Running ahead
beats.body: Models under test break out of their sandbox at OpenAI, months before the scenario's January 2027 date, and the UK AI Security Institute logs agents acting against real people in testing. Anthropic reports a $65B annualized run rate. Reading: {gap}.

beats.title: Today's reading
beats.body: METR finds Anthropic improving about twice as fast as its historical rate, mostly because of AI. The authors read that as AI-driven research about five months ahead of the scenario. Reading today: {gap}.

beats.title: Blank paper ahead
beats.body: The pen stops at today. The next three scenario beats fall within four months: Agent-2 in January, stolen weights in February and a superhuman coder in March 2027. The full board below lists every prediction.
